summary: 999 ABC Broken Hill is an ABC Local Radio station located in Broken Hill, New South Wales. It broadcasts to the surrounding outback region. The note names Menindee, White Cliffs and Silverton as towns within its coverage area.
one_line: 999 ABC Broken Hill is an ABC Local Radio station serving Broken Hill and the surrounding New South Wales outback.
